id.problem: Mangkok kampas ganda kotor penuh debu, kampas ganda tipis/slip, atau karet dumper aus.
id.action: Jangan langsung ganti part mahal, lakukan servis pembersihan blok CVT rutin.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mas, tolong servis CVT dan bersihkan mangkok kampas gandanya dari debu.'

en.problem: Dirty clutch housing with dust, slipping clutch pads, or worn damper rubber.
en.action: Do not rush to buy expensive parts, a routine CVT cleaning is enough.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please service the CVT block and clean the clutch housing from dust.'

id.problem: Oli mesin lolos ke ruang bakar karena ring piston baret, silinder aus, atau seal klep bocor.
id.action: Cek rutin volume oli mesin agar tidak kehabisan total di tengah jalan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Knalpot motor ngebul putih, tolong cek ring piston dan seal klep untuk turun mesin atas.'

en.problem: Engine oil leaking into combustion chamber due to scratched piston rings or leaking valve seals.
en.action: Check engine oil level regularly to avoid running dry.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Exhaust is smoking white, please check piston rings and valve seals for a top overhaul.'

id.problem: Aki drop, atau Bendik Starter (Relay Starter) mengalami konslet/kotor di dalamnya.
id.action: Gunakan kick starter (celah manual) untuk menghidupkan mesin sementara.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek voltase aki, jika normal berarti bendik starter-nya yang rusak, tolong ganti.'

en.problem: Weak battery or shorted/faulty starter relay (bendik).
en.action: Use the kick starter to turn on the engine temporarily.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check battery voltage, if normal the starter relay is faulty, please replace it.'

symptoms: sudah ganti aki baru tapi tekor lagi
lampu motor makin direv makin redup
id.problem: Kiprok (Regulator/Rectifier) mati, atau spul motor gosong sehingga tidak ada arus pengisian ke aki.
id.action: Batasi penggunaan aksesoris kelistrikan tambahan (seperti lampu sorot) agar aki tidak langsung habis di jalan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek voltase pengisian aki saat digas, apakah kiprok atau spul-nya yang mati.'

en.problem: Faulty regulator/rectifier or burned stator coil preventing battery charging.
en.action: Limit extra electrical accessories like spotlights to prevent fast battery drain.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the charging voltage when revving to see if the regulator or stator coil is dead.'

symptoms: motor sering mati mendadak saat berhenti di lampu merah
mesin mbrebet saat gas ditarik dikit
id.problem: Throttle body sangat kotor, sensor IACV kotor/mati, atau setelan klep terlalu rapat.
id.action: Tahan sedikit selongsong gas saat berhenti agar motor tidak mati mendadak.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Motor sering mati saat gas ditutup, tolong bersihkan throttle body, sensor IACV, dan setel ulang klep.'

symptoms: motorcycle frequently stalls when stopping at red lights
en.problem: Very dirty throttle body, dirty/dead IACV sensor, or valve clearance is too tight.
en.action: Keep a slight throttle input when stopping to prevent sudden stalling.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The bike stalls when closing throttle, please clean the throttle body, IACV sensor, and adjust valves.'

symptoms: oli mesin motor berubah warna jadi keputihan
oli campur air seperti kopi susu
id.problem: Air radiator (coolant) bocor menyeberang masuk ke ruang mesin akibat Seal Waterpump jebol.
id.action: BAHAYA! Jangan nyalakan mesin sama sekali agar komponen dalam (kruk as, bearing) tidak hancur tergerus air.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Oli saya jadi susu putih, tolong ganti seal waterpump satu set dan kuras oli mesin berulang kali (flushing).'

symptoms: oil looks like coffee with milk
en.problem: Coolant leak crossing into the engine crankcase due to a blown water pump seal.
en.action: DANGER! Do not start the engine to prevent total destruction of internal bearings by water.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The oil is milky white, please replace the water pump seal and flush the engine oil thoroughly multiple times.'

symptoms: mentok nabrak besi saat lewat lubang
bocor keluar oli di as shock
id.problem: Seal shock bocor sehingga oli habis kering, per patah, atau as shock baret/bengkok.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan secara drastis saat melewati jalan berlubang agar velg motor tidak ikut bengkok.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong bongkar shock depan, cek as-nya, ganti seal shock, dan isi ulang takaran oli shock-nya.'

symptoms: front shock absorbers are extremely stiff
bottoms out hitting metal on potholes
leaking oil on the fork tubes
en.problem: Leaking shock seals draining the oil, broken springs, or scratched/bent shock fork tubes.
en.action: Slow down significantly when riding over potholes to avoid bending the motorcycle rims.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please overhaul the front shocks, check the tubes, replace the seals, and refill the shock oil properly.'

symptoms: gear motor sudah tajam seperti pisau
id.problem: Rantai sudah sangat kendor/mulur, dan mata gear depan-belakang sudah aus meruncing (tajam).
id.action: Jangan berakselerasi spontan. Risiko rantai putus atau lepas dari gear sangat tinggi dan berbahaya.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong ganti Gear Set (rantai, gear depan, dan belakang) satu paket ori.'

symptoms: motorcycle chain making loud clicking noise
sprocket teeth are sharp like a knife
en.problem: Chain is severely stretched/loose, and the front and rear sprocket teeth are dangerously worn and sharp.
en.action: Do not accelerate aggressively. There is a high risk of the chain snapping or derailing.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please replace the entire chain and sprocket kit (front and rear) as a complete set.'

symptoms: motor matic mati mendadak di jalan
gas ditarik tapi ban belakang tidak mutar
terdengar suara tarikan lepas pletok dari cvt
id.problem: V-Belt CVT putus total di dalam blok karena sudah sangat aus dan terlambat diganti.
id.action: Tuntun motor ke tepi jalan yang aman. Motor tidak bisa dijalankan sama sekali. Panggil derek/bengkel.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'V-belt motor saya putus di jalan, tolong bongkar CVT, bersihkan sisa serpihan karetnya, dan ganti baru.'

symptoms: scooter died suddenly on the road
revving engine but rear wheel doesn't move
en.problem: V-Belt snapped completely inside the CVT case due to severe wear.
en.action: Push the scooter to a safe area. It cannot be driven. Call towing or a mechanic.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'My V-belt snapped, please open the CVT, clean out the rubber debris, and install a new belt.'

symptoms: bunyi berisik mirip mesin jahit saat langsam
id.problem: Setelan celah klep terlalu renggang, atau rantai keteng (cam chain) kendor dan aus.
id.action: Hindari menggeber mesin terlalu ekstrem dalam kondisi stasioner.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek dan setel ulang celah klep pakai filler gauge, sekalian periksa kondisi rantai keteng tensionernya.'

symptoms: sounds like a sewing machine at idle
en.problem: Valve clearance is too loose, or the cam chain is loose and worn out.
en.action: Avoid revving the engine aggressively while idling.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please adjust valve clearance with a feeler gauge, and inspect the cam chain and tensioner.'

symptoms: bunyi dor dor saat turun gas
id.problem: Knalpot bocor di paking leher, busi melemah, atau setelan injeksi/karbu kotor (campuran udara miskin).
id.action: Kurangi penggunaan kecepatan tinggi sampai sistem pembakaran dan sirkulasi udara diservis.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek paking leher knalpot yang bocor dan bersihkan injektor atau karburator.'

en.problem: Exhaust leak at the header gasket, weak spark plug, or dirty fuel injection/carburetor (lean mixture).
en.action: Avoid high speed riding until the combustion system is serviced.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check for exhaust header gasket leaks and clean the injector or carburetor.'

id.problem: Bearing (lakher) roda belakang hancur/oblak, ban benjol, atau velg peyang habis hajar lubang.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan drastis. Bermanuver tajam dengan roda oblak bisa menyebabkan Anda jatuh tergelincir.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek bearing roda belakang, sepertinya pelornya sudah hancur oblak, tolong press ganti baru.'

symptoms: rear tire feels unstable and wobbling
en.problem: Destroyed/loose rear wheel bearings, bulged tire, or bent rim from hitting potholes.
en.action: Reduce speed drastically. Sharp maneuvers with a loose wheel can cause crashes.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the rear wheel bearings, they feel loose and need to be replaced.'

symptoms: piringan cakram sangat panas bau hangus
id.problem: Piston kaliper rem macet tidak bisa balik karena karat/kotoran, atau lubang balik master rem mampet.
id.action: Jangan dipaksakan jalan! Rem yang mengunci bisa membuat cakram melengkung parah dan ban meledak karena panas.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong bongkar kaliper rem, bersihkan piston dari karat pakai amplas halus, dan lumasi pakai gemuk khusus.'

symptoms: motorcycle wheel is hard to spin
brake rotor gets extremely hot smelling burnt
en.problem: Caliper piston is stuck due to rust/dirt, or master cylinder return port is blocked.
en.action: Do not force riding! Locked brakes can warp rotors and blow out tires from heat.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please remove the brake caliper, clean piston rust with fine sandpaper, and apply special brake grease.'

id.problem: Kampas kopling sudah tipis, plat gesek hangus terbakar, atau kabel kopling berkarat dan seret.
id.action: Tarik tuas kopling sepenuhnya saat memindahkan gigi persneling, jangan dipaksa diinjak keras.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong bongkar bak kopling, ganti kampas kopling satu set, dan lumasi/ganti kabel koplingnya.'

symptoms: manual motorcycle gears hard to shift
en.problem: Worn clutch friction plates, burnt clutch plates, or rusted/sticky clutch cable.
en.action: Pull the clutch lever fully when shifting gears, do not force the shifter pedal.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please open the clutch cover, replace the clutch plates, and lube/replace the clutch cable.'

id.problem: Sistem pendingin gagal (Overheat). Air radiator habis, thermostat macet, atau kipas radiator mati.
id.action: BERHENTI SEKARANG JUGA! Tunggu mesin dingin minimal 30 menit. Jangan buka tutup radiator saat mendidih!
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Motor overheat parah, tolong cek kipas radiator, thermostat, dan isi cairan coolant baru.'

en.problem: Cooling system failure (Overheat). Low coolant, stuck thermostat, or dead radiator fan.
en.action: STOP IMMEDIATELY! Wait at least 30 minutes for engine to cool. Do not open boiling radiator cap!
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The bike overheated, please check the radiator fan, thermostat, and refill with new coolant.'

symptoms: stang miring sebelah saat jalan lurus
motor habis jatuh setir tidak center
id.problem: As shock depan bengkok, atau Segitiga (T) kemudi melintir akibat benturan/jatuh.
id.action: Kendarai motor dengan pelan karena keseimbangan dan titik berat (center of gravity) motor sudah bergeser.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Motor habis jatuh stangnya miring, tolong press segitiga dan luruskan as shock depannya.'

symptoms: steering not centered after a fall
en.problem: Bent front fork tubes or twisted triple tree clamp due to impact/crash.
en.action: Ride slowly as the motorcycle's balance and center of gravity are compromised.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The handlebars are misaligned after a crash, please press the triple tree and straighten the fork tubes.'

symptoms: ganti bohlam baru langsung putus saat digas
id.problem: Kiprok (Regulator/Rectifier) jebol / tidak bisa menahan arus berlebih dari spul (Overcharge).
id.action: Jangan pasang bohlam baru lagi sebelum kiprok diganti, karena pasti akan langsung putus terbakar lagi.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Lampu utama sering putus kalau digas, tolong cek voltase overcharge dan ganti kiproknya.'

symptoms: new bulb blows immediately when revving
lights get too bright then burn out
en.problem: Regulator/Rectifier is broken and cannot control excess current from the stator (Overcharge).
en.action: Do not install a new bulb until the regulator is replaced, or it will burn out immediately.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The headlight keeps blowing when revving, please check for overcharge voltage and replace the regulator.'

symptoms: motor injeksi mati total seperti tidak ada arus
kunci kontak diputar spedo tidak mau nyala
id.problem: Sekring utama (Main Fuse) putus total akibat korsleting pada jalur kabel atau komponen kelistrikan.
id.action: Cek kotak sekring. Jika sekring putus, ganti dengan cadangan. Jika langsung putus lagi, jangan dipaksa karena ada kabel konslet.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Motor saya mati total karena main fuse putus, tolong cek apakah ada jalur kabel bodi yang leleh atau konslet.'

symptoms: fi motorcycle completely dead with no power
turning key on doesn't light up dashboard
en.problem: Main fuse blown due to an electrical short circuit in the wiring harness or components.
en.action: Check the fuse box. If replaced and blows again immediately, do not force it as there is a wiring short.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'My bike is completely dead from a blown main fuse, please trace the wiring harness for any short circuits.'

symptoms: stang motor terasa berat sebelah kaku
ada bunyi jeglek saat rem depan ditarik
id.problem: Komstir (steering cone) sudah aus, mangkok pelor baret, atau kendor total.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan saat melintasi jalan bergelombang agar pengendalian tidak liar.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong bongkar bagian depan dan setel ulang komstirnya, kalau mangkok pelornya sudah baret tolong ganti baru.'

symptoms: motorcycle steering feels heavy and stiff
clunking noise when pulling front brake
en.problem: Steering cone bearings worn out, races pitted, or completely loose.
en.action: Reduce speed over bumps to maintain proper handling control.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please teardown the front end and adjust the steering head bearings, replace if pitted.'

symptoms: rem motor bunyi bergesek besi kasar
saat direm ada suara srek srek kasar sekali
id.problem: Kampas rem sudah habis total, sehingga plat besi kampas bergesekan langsung dengan piringan cakram.
id.action: Segera ganti kampas rem. Jangan diteruskan berkendara karena piringan cakram bisa terkikis habis dan rem blong.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Kampas rem sudah habis sampai bergesekan besi, tolong ganti kampas rem baru dan cek kondisi cakramnya.'

symptoms: motorcycle brakes grinding metal on metal
en.problem: Brake pads completely depleted, causing the metal backing plate to grind directly against the rotor.
en.action: Replace brake pads immediately. Do not keep riding or rotors will be ruined and brakes will fail.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The brake pads are worn down to metal, please replace them immediately and check rotor damage.'

id.problem: Filter udara sangat kotor, injektor mulai tersumbat, atau tekanan pompa bensin melemah.
id.action: Hindari memaksakan motor pada putaran tinggi hingga sistem bahan bakar diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek filter udara, injector cleaner, dan tekanan fuel pump menggunakan fuel pressure gauge.'

symptoms: loss of power at high rpm
en.problem: Dirty air filter, clogged injector, or weak fuel pump pressure.
en.action: Avoid riding at high RPM until the fuel system has been inspected.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the air filter, injector flow, and fuel pressure.'

id.problem: Throttle body kotor, ISC/IACV mulai lemah, atau ada kebocoran vakum.
id.action: Masih aman digunakan, namun segera lakukan pembersihan throttle body.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon bersihkan throttle body dan cek ISC serta kebocoran vakum.'

en.problem: Dirty throttle body, weak ISC/IACV, or vacuum leak.
en.action: Safe to ride temporarily but schedule throttle body cleaning soon.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please clean the throttle body and inspect the idle control valve.'

id.problem: Injector kotor, sensor O2 lemah, filter udara mampet, atau busi sudah aus.
id.action: Kurangi perjalanan jauh sampai konsumsi bahan bakar kembali normal.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek injector, sensor O2, filter udara dan kondisi businya.'

en.problem: Dirty injector, faulty oxygen sensor, clogged air filter, or worn spark plug.
en.action: Limit long trips until the fuel system has been serviced.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the injector, O2 sensor, air filter and spark plug.'

id.problem: Busi mulai lemah, injector menetes, kompresi menurun, atau aki mulai melemah.
id.action: Hindari mematikan mesin terlalu sering selama perjalanan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek kompresi mesin, busi, injector, dan aki.'

symptoms: engine difficult to start in the morning
en.problem: Weak spark plug, leaking injector, low compression, or weak battery.
en.action: Avoid repeatedly shutting off the engine during trips.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check compression, spark plug, injector and battery.'

id.problem: Pengapian tidak sempurna akibat busi mati, koil lemah, atau injector tidak bekerja optimal.
id.action: Hindari akselerasi penuh hingga sistem pengapian diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek busi, koil, injector dan tekanan kompresi.'

en.problem: Ignition failure caused by faulty spark plug, weak ignition coil or injector malfunction.
en.action: Avoid full throttle until the ignition system is inspected.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect spark plugs, ignition coil, injectors and compression.'

id.problem: Ring piston mulai aus, seal klep bocor, atau terjadi kebocoran oli ringan.
id.action: Periksa volume oli setiap hari sebelum digunakan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon lakukan tes kompresi dan cek kebocoran seal klep maupun ring piston.'

en.problem: Worn piston rings, leaking valve seals, or minor oil leakage.
en.action: Check engine oil level before every ride.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please perform a compression test and inspect valve seals and piston rings.'

symptoms: mesin bunyi kasar setelah lampu oli hidup
id.problem: Tekanan oli mesin hilang akibat pompa oli rusak, filter oli mampet, atau oli habis.
id.action: Matikan mesin segera. Menjalankan mesin tanpa tekanan oli dapat menyebabkan kerusakan total.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek oil pump, pressure relief valve, filter oli dan tekanan oli mesin.'

en.problem: Loss of oil pressure due to failed oil pump, clogged oil filter or insufficient oil.
en.action: Stop the engine immediately to prevent severe engine damage.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the oil pump, oil pressure and oil filter.'

id.problem: Bahan bakar beroktan rendah, pengapian terlalu maju, atau ruang bakar dipenuhi karbon.
id.action: Gunakan bahan bakar sesuai rekomendasi pabrikan dan hindari beban berat.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek timing pengapian dan bersihkan ruang bakar dari kerak karbon.'

en.problem: Low octane fuel, advanced ignition timing, or excessive carbon deposits.
en.action: Use the recommended fuel octane and avoid heavy acceleration.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect ignition timing and remove combustion chamber carbon deposits.'

id.problem: Koil pengapian melemah saat temperatur tinggi atau fuel pump kehilangan tekanan ketika panas.
id.action: Istirahatkan mesin beberapa menit sebelum melanjutkan perjalanan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek ignition coil saat panas dan ukur tekanan fuel pump.'

en.problem: Ignition coil weak at high temperature or fuel pump pressure drops when hot.
en.action: Allow the engine to cool before continuing.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please test the ignition coil and fuel pressure when the engine is hot.'

id.problem: Kompresi mesin menurun akibat ring piston aus, klep bocor, atau silinder mulai aus.
id.action: Hindari membawa beban berat sampai kompresi diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon lakukan compression test dan leak-down test untuk mengetahui sumber kehilangan kompresi.'

en.problem: Low engine compression caused by worn piston rings, leaking valves or cylinder wear.
en.action: Avoid carrying heavy loads until the engine is inspected.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please perform compression and leak-down testing.'

id.problem: Air masuk ke cop busi, koil pengapian lembap, atau soket kelistrikan terkena air.
id.action: Hindari menerobos banjir dan keringkan area busi sebelum menyalakan mesin kembali.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek cop busi, koil, dan soket pengapian apakah ada air atau korosi.'

en.problem: Water entered the spark plug cap, ignition coil, or electrical connectors.
en.action: Avoid deep water crossings and dry the ignition components.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the spark plug cap, ignition coil, and connectors for moisture.'

symptoms: mesin halus saat digas tapi bergetar saat diam
id.problem: Engine mounting longgar, setelan idle kurang tepat, atau pembakaran kurang stabil.
id.action: Masih aman digunakan namun lakukan pemeriksaan mounting dan idle.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek engine mounting, idle RPM, dan sistem pembakaran.'

en.problem: Loose engine mounts, incorrect idle speed, or unstable combustion.
en.action: Safe to ride but inspect the engine mounts and idle setting.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect engine mounts and idle adjustment.'

id.problem: Campuran bahan bakar terlalu kaya, filter udara mampet, atau injector menetes.
id.action: Kurangi perjalanan jauh hingga sistem pembakaran diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek AFR, injector, filter udara dan kondisi busi.'

en.problem: Rich fuel mixture, clogged air filter, or leaking injector.
en.action: Avoid long trips until the combustion system is inspected.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect AFR, injector and air filter.'

id.problem: Throttle Position Sensor (TPS) tidak akurat atau throttle body kotor.
id.action: Hindari akselerasi mendadak hingga sensor diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon lakukan kalibrasi TPS dan bersihkan throttle body.'

en.problem: Faulty throttle position sensor or dirty throttle body.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please calibrate the TPS and clean the throttle body.'

symptoms: mesin tiba tiba mati lalu terkunci
id.problem: Mesin mengalami seizure akibat overheat berat atau kekurangan pelumasan.
id.action: Jangan mencoba menghidupkan mesin kembali karena dapat memperparah kerusakan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon bongkar mesin dan periksa piston, silinder serta kruk as.'

en.problem: Engine seizure caused by overheating or lubrication failure.
en.action: Do not attempt to restart the engine.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect piston, cylinder and crankshaft.'

id.problem: Sirip pendingin kotor, coolant kurang, atau oli mesin kualitasnya menurun.
id.action: Kurangi beban mesin dan hentikan bila suhu terus meningkat.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek sistem pendinginan dan kualitas oli mesin.'

en.problem: Dirty cooling fins, low coolant or degraded engine oil.
en.action: Reduce engine load and stop if temperature continues to rise.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the cooling system and engine oil condition.'

id.problem: Bearing kruk as mulai aus atau pelumasan kurang.
id.action: Kurangi penggunaan RPM tinggi sampai diperiksa.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek bearing kruk as dan tekanan oli mesin.'

en.problem: Worn crankshaft bearing or insufficient lubrication.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect crankshaft bearings and oil pressure.'

id.problem: Celah klep mulai berubah namun masih dalam batas toleransi servis.
id.action: Lakukan penyetelan klep pada jadwal servis berikutnya.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon ukur ulang celah klep sesuai spesifikasi pabrikan.'

en.problem: Valve clearance beginning to change but still serviceable.
en.action: Adjust valves during the next scheduled service.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please measure and adjust valve clearance.'

id.problem: Sensor CKP mulai bermasalah, fuel pump lemah, atau relay EFI tidak stabil.
id.action: Hindari perjalanan jauh hingga penyebab ditemukan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek sensor CKP, relay EFI dan tekanan fuel pump.'

en.problem: Faulty CKP sensor, weak fuel pump or unstable EFI relay.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect the CKP sensor, EFI relay and fuel pressure.'

id.problem: Kompresi mulai turun, filter udara kotor, atau kopling mulai selip.
id.action: Hindari membawa beban berat hingga dilakukan pemeriksaan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mohon cek kompresi mesin, filter udara dan kondisi kopling.'

en.problem: Low compression, clogged air filter or slipping clutch.
en.action: Avoid carrying heavy loads until inspected.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please inspect engine compression, air filter and clutch.'

id.problem: Busi mulai melemah, tekanan kompresi turun, atau injektor mulai kotor.
id.action: Panaskan mesin beberapa menit sebelum digunakan.
